blocks.orig: Anantya Serengeti is a tented camp in the central part of Serengeti National Park, just a few minutes’ drive from the Seronera Airstrip. The camp has luxury tents with indoor and outdoor showers, walk-in wardrobes, sundecks, iPads for ordering or entertainment, and one or two king-sized beds (extra beds are available on request). A nearby river even allows you to spot wildlife right from the terrace of your tent! For your meals, you can choose to have bush breakfasts, picnics, or dinner under the stars. A bar is stocked with soft drinks, beers, and wine, and a campfire is there to light up your evenings.
